title.value: Take All Menstrual Product-PFAS Out Now (T.A.M.P.O.N.) Act
title.provenance: SEC. 1. This act shall be known, and may be cited, as the Take All Menstrual Product-PFAS Out Now (T.A.M.P.O.N.) Act.

location.provenance: An act to add Article 15 (commencing with Section 25258) to Chapter 6.5 of Division 20 of the Health and Safety Code, relating to public health.

reference.provenance: AB-2515 Menstrual products: perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS).

status.provenance: An act to add Article 15 (commencing with Section 25258) to Chapter 6.5 of Division 20 of the Health and Safety Code, relating to public health.

pfas_definition.provenance: ÒPerfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substancesÓ or ÒPFASÓ means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: 25258.3. A person shall not manufacture, distribute, sell, or offer for sale in the state a menstrual product that contains regulated PFAS.

date.provenance: Commencing January 1, 2025, PFAS that a manufacturer has intentionally added to a product and that have a functional or technical effect in the product, including the PFAS components of intentionally added chemicals and PFAS that are intentional breakdown products of an added chemical that also have a functional or technical effect in the product.

who.provenance: 25258.3. A person shall not manufacture, distribute, sell, or offer for sale in the state a menstrual product that contains regulated PFAS.

action.provenance: 25258.3. A person shall not manufacture, distribute, sell, or offer for sale in the state a menstrual product that contains regulated PFAS.

products.provenance: ÒMenstrual productÓ means a product used to collect menstruation and vaginal discharge, including, but not limited to, tampons, pads, sponges, menstruation underwear, disks, and menstrual cups, whether disposable or reusable.

intentionally_added.provenance: Commencing January 1, 2025, PFAS that a manufacturer has intentionally added to a product and that have a functional or technical effect in the product, including the PFAS components of intentionally added chemicals and PFAS that are intentional breakdown products of an added chemical that also have a functional or technical effect in the product.

type.provenance: 25258.3. A person shall not manufacture, distribute, sell, or offer for sale in the state a menstrual product that contains regulated PFAS.

date.provenance: Commencing January 1, 2027, the presence of PFAS in a product or product component at or above a limit determined by the department, as measured in total organic fluorine.
